name: hidden_stems
lineage: 子平 Ziping, 《淵海子平》「又地支藏遁歌」
source: 《淵海子平》卷一「又地支藏遁歌」 (子宮癸水在其中，丑癸辛金己土同 ...), read on 2026-10-13 in the transcription at donglishuzhai.net/chapter/12808.html, collated there against the 文明書局 and 大成堂 editions; the same text is on zh.wikisource.org/wiki/淵海子平.
notes: The stems of all twelve branches agree with the verse. Checked against a transcription, not a printed edition. The verse gives its stems in the order the metre wants: the order here, principal (本氣) first, is the customary one and is not from the verse. 《三命通會》「論三刑」 agrees in passing for 子 (子中獨用癸水) and 卯 (卯中獨用乙木). Other tables differ: see hidden_stems.siling.v1.
order: principal (本氣), middle (中氣), residual (餘氣)
